Samir Patel: Quick heads-up — I found two broken links in the Optimize Toolkit doc and one duplicated JS SDK snippet that causes the example app to crash when using the caching example. Opening an emergency docs PR now.

Tanya Li: Thanks Samir. Which pages? can you paste the links and the snippet?

Samir Patel: Sure — the links: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/toolkit/batching -> 404 and the internal anchor https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/toolkit#cache-profiles redirects to old section. Also the JS snippet under /examples/sdk/caching-v2.js has the old param name `batchSize` instead of `batching.size`, which the v2 SDK validator rejects. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332 (draft)

Kevin Zhao: Ugh, that anchor shift happened after the restructure last week. I bumped the headings but didn't add redirects. I can add redirect rules in the site config — will that break anything?

Tanya Li: Redirects are fine. For the snippet, can we update the example and add a short note about migrating from v1 -> v2? We keep getting support tickets about cache config mismatch.

Samir Patel: Proposed snippet change (will push to PR in a sec):
```js
// caching-v2.js (recommended)
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  batching: { size: 8, maxLatencyMs: 25 },
  cache: { type: 'prefix', ttlSeconds: 3600 }
});

await client.generate({ model: 'rw-2-small', prompt: 'Hello' });
```
Also adding a one-liner migration note: "In v2 the batching config moved under `batching` and cache options are explicit under `cache` — see the SDK migration guide."

Ryan S.: docs-ci-bot just flagged the PR for a link check failure — will wait for the redirect before approving. @docs-ci-bot do a re-run after commits? :eyes:

docs-ci-bot: CI triggered for PR #4332 — link-check found 2 broken links, 1 JS lint warning. Re-run with `ci/recheck` comment.

Kevin Zhao: I'll add the redirect rule and push a tiny patch. Samir, can you add the migration note and update the snippet to use `batching.size` (you have `size` nested under `batching` already, sgtm)? Also add an inline test in examples/__tests__/caching.spec.js that validates config shape so the CI catches regressions.

Samir Patel: On it. Pushing three commits: redirect, example update + test, docs copy note. Will comment `ci/recheck` once CI is green.

Tanya Li: Awesome — once green, I'll merge and backfill a short changelog entry for the Optimize Toolkit section. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: Done — CI green after fixes. PR updated with commits and changelog snippet. Re-requesting review from @Tanya and @Kevin.

Kevin Zhao: Quick glance — tests + link-check pass. LGTM, merging now.

Tanya Li: Merged. Thank you both. I'll pick a follow-up to sweep other anchors later this week.

Samir Patel: Thanks! Filing a tiny follow-up issue to audit toolkit anchors across the site.

Ryan S.: Noted in tracking board (#DOCS-1287). Great turnaround.
